papers.title_en: Learning Provable Neural Network Observer for Uncertain Dynamical Systems
papers.authors: Zhangyi Wang, Jiaxu Liu, Chen Song, Chao Xu, Shengze Cai
papers.evidence: 用李雅普诺夫稳定性与LMI约束的神经网络观测器
papers.tldr: 不确定动力系统安全控制常需观测器估计状态与外部扰动，神经网络观测器虽能提升精度，但用LMI约束认证Lyapunov稳定性会带来大规模SDP求解瓶颈。本文提出两阶段可证明稳定训练框架：先以点引导Lyapunov预训练快速获得高精度和局部稳定，再通过LMI微调满足严格全局Lyapunov稳定证书。理论上给出局部稳定半径与概率覆盖保证。在非线性控制基准和X-29飞机实验中，该方法训练显著快于直接LMI方法，泛化稳健并提升跟踪精度。
papers.abstract_en: In many safety-critical applications, control of uncertain dynamical systems relies on observers that estimate states and external disturbances. Neural network observers can improve estimation accuracy, but certifying their Lyapunov stability via Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) constraints leads to large-scale semidefinite programs (SDPs) that are difficult to solve for large networks. To overcome this scalability bottleneck, we propose a novel two-stage training framework for provably stable neural network observers. Our approach decouples the optimization into a point-guided Lyapunov pre-training phase, which rapidly achieves high estimation accuracy and local stability over sampled states, followed by an LMI fine-tuning phase that efficiently satisfies a strict global Lyapunov stability certificate. We provide formal theoretical guarantees for local stability radii and probabilistic coverage over a prescribed compact error-state domain under specified regularity and sampling assumptions. Experiments on nonlinear control benchmarks and X-29 aircraft ablations show that our LMI-certified neural network observers train significantly faster than direct LMI-based methods and generalize robustly across diverse systems, achieving improved tracking accuracy over a range of observer baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Berry-Myon/LearningNeuralNetworkObserver.
